dedupe_keys.name: grid frequency measurements of the continental european power system during 2019

description: Grid Frequency Measurements of the Continental European Power System during 2019 is a data set deposited in DTU Data by its authors Andreas Thingvad, Mattia Marinelli (Technical University of Denmark). The grid frequency is measured Central Jutland, Denmark (DK-1), which is a part of the Continental European power system (ENTSOE RG-CE). 342.5 days are measured with the DEIF MTR-3 22.5 days are not measured. Coverage: continental (DK); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 299982674 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
